messages:
maya: FYI I opened a follow-up PR to consolidate structured-output migration notes + extra SDK snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1435. Quick reviews appreciated.
kevin: scanning. main thing: we need a clear migration table v1 -> v2 for method names and error types. Users keep hitting parseStructuredResponse -> structured.parse mismatch.
sajal: agree. also add an example showing how to accept optional keys safely (use `oneOf` with null) and a defensive parse pattern.
maya: current plan in the PR: 1) migration table, 2) TS + Python snippets under examples/, 3) parsing patterns section (strict/forgiving/heuristic), 4) note about guardrail policy.
oli: I wrote a short TS snippet for SDK v2 usage: shows structured.parse call, schema attach, and a try/catch with fallback to manual JSON.parse. will add to examples/typescript.md and link from the guide.
marta: please include ops note: console toggle per-route to control strictness (Strict/Lenient). also CLI repro: `rwdctl logs --route my-bot --filter validation_failures`. mention how failures surface in traces.
ryan: I'll prepare a playground template that imports the schema and example prompt. can we standardize the schema filename so the playground can fetch `/examples/schemas/recommendations.json`?
kevin: +1 for standard filenames. also suggest adding a tiny test prompt for array-of-objects e.g. "List three recommendations with title, score (optional), and metadata (nullable)".
doc-lint-bot: broken anchor: /docs/guides/structured-output#parsing-patterns -> anchor mismatch.
maya: thanks bot. I'll fix the anchor and the breadcrumbs.
sajal: for parsing patterns I'm proposing three 6-line snippets: 1) strict validator (throws on invalid), 2) forgiving parser (logs validation errors and keeps best-effort), 3) heuristic extractor: try JSON first, then regex to pull last JSON block, then JSON.parse. Users love the last-resort trick.
oli: quick note for the TS snippet: use `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'` then `const parsed = await client.structured.parse(response, schema)` for v2. include comment about v1 name.
marta: mention guardrail behaviour: on validation fail we retry once by adding a clarifying system message. if still invalid, we emit an event with tag `structured_output.invalid_schema` and fallback to plain text. show the timeline and a sample event payload in the ops note.
kevin: small wording nit in the migration table: rename column "oldName" -> "v1" and "newName" -> "v2" for clarity.
maya: will update. I also added a short Python snippet that mirrors TS: `client.structured.parse(...)`, plus a try/except and a fallback that attempts line-delimited JSON parsing.
ryan: playground template ready, linking to `/examples/schemas/recommendations.json`. I added a copy button suggestion in the docs so users can paste schema into the playground quickly.
doc-lint-bot: style: prefer sentence case in heading 'Migration Notes' -> 'Migration notes'.
maya: fixing headings now. After I push these edits, can @kevin do a final sweep on schema examples? need someone to validate the JSON Schema samples.
kevin: will do a quick pass tonight.
sajal: after merge let's open an ISSUE to add an observability tutorial showing how to alert on the `structured_output.invalid_schema` metric. customers requested that in the last support call.
maya: created ISSUE-328 for that. merging after kevin approves. thanks everyone! :sparkles:
